Name: Relaxing Bundles Redux
Author: CaptainWolfe11
Description:
Hello Everyone! I loved [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/tcjaime/about-me?gameId=1303]tcjaime's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6574?tab=description]Relaxing Bundles[/url] mod so much, so when I wanted to add it to my 1.6 playthrough, I learned how to update the files so I could get it working for myself. Since getting tcjaime's permission, I decided to post it here for people in case they want it too.

Any endorsements you might give to this mod, please give to tcjaime's original mod, which was the basis of this update!

I made one small sneaky change......I added a reward to the Missing Bundle - two Auto Petters. I really hate petting my animals but didn't want to use cheats to get the Auto Petter, or slog through Skull Cavern. There are two files to choose from in the downloads - one that gives the Auto Petters and one that doesn't, depending on your playstyle.

Please be aware, you have to install this mod before a new game for it to take effect. Also, users have reported issues with removing bundle altering mods mid-way through playthrough.

Thanks to tcjaime and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild/about-me?gameId=1303]Pathoschild[/url] for the original mod and Content Patcher, respectively!
